notes: Architecture is clean and well-separated: each service owns its store and never imports other services; inter-service communication is via the Event Bus; HTTP handling is confined to the router. All required services and endpoints are implemented, including member management, task assignment, forward-only status changes, comment CRUD, and notifications for the specified events. The demo script thoroughly exercises the API and edge cases. Code quality is high: consistent ServiceResult pattern, solid input validation, typed event payloads, and idiomatic TypeScript. Minor nit: the router enriches comment creation by calling multiple services, which is acceptable here but introduces some orchestration coupling; otherwise, the implementation is robust and adheres to all constraints.
